direct_sql: WITH yearly_consumption AS ( SELECT customers.Segment, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(yearmonth.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN yearmonth.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(yearmonth.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN yearmonth.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013 FROM yearmonth JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID WHERE customers.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND customers.Currency = 'EUR' AND substr(yearmonth.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013') GROUP BY customers.Segment ), percentage_increases AS ( SELECT yearly_consumption.Segment, (yearly_consumption.consumption_2013 - yearly_consumption.consumption_2012) * 100.0 / NULLIF(yearly_consumption.consumption_2013, 0) AS percentage_increase FROM yearly_consumption ) SELECT percentage_increases.Segment, percentage_increases.percentage_increase FROM percentage_increases WHERE percentage_increases.percentage_increase = ( SELECT MAX(percentage_increases.percentage_increase) FROM percentage_increases ) OR percentage_increases.percentage_increase = ( SELECT MIN(percentage_increases.percentage_increase) FROM percentage_increases )
